Print a PrismReport

Source: R/print.PrismReport.R
print.PrismReport.Rd

Print a PrismReport

Usage

# S3 method for class 'PrismReport'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A PrismReport object returned by prism.

...

Additional arguments passed to print methods.

Value

Invisibly returns the input PrismReport object.

Examples

report <- prism(airquality, target = "Ozone")
print(report)
